seo.title: Website redesigns, before and after
seo.description: Client websites before and after we rebuilt them, compared on the same screen, with the load time, bounce rate and enquiries measured on each side.

copy.title: Website redesigns, before and after
copy.intro: Most of our work is a rescue, not a launch. Drag each comparison to see a client's homepage before and after the rebuild, at the same scroll position on the same screen, with the figures that moved.
copy.empty: No before and after comparisons are published at the moment. Our case studies show what changed for each client, in figures.

comparisons.heading: What changed when HelloWay's website was redesigned?
comparisons.summary: A dated homepage rebuilt around a clear headline, a photograph and result figures, compared at the same scroll position on the same screen.

before.alt: The HelloWay travel website before the redesign, on a laptop: a crowded early-2000s page with a yellow banner, a blue sidebar of links, a scrolling offer and a visitor counter

after.alt: The HelloWay travel website after the redesign, on the same laptop: a clean menu, a full-width photograph under the headline Your Next Adventure Starts Here, and a row of destination photographs
